request_json.title: KiteLoad historical evidence inventory
request_json.text: Historical evidence inventory for R-731, compiled 2028-05-22. The only retained run-specific artifacts supplied here are the completion receipt and alert-card transcription. The worker attempt ledger was not exported before its 24-hour retention expired. No run-time configuration snapshot, upstream request trace, or per-attempt failure record is available in this evidence bundle. Establishing that a retry happened requires an authoritative retry counter or linked per-attempt execution records. Attributing an attempt failure to upstream rate limiting requires a corresponding upstream response or correlated failure record; retry settings alone cannot establish a cause.
